data.title: Vice Foreign Minister Receives Egyptian Ambassador to Saudi Arabia
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs Waleed Elkhereiji received Ambassador of the Arab Republic of Egypt to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Hatem Abdelkader in Riyadh today.
    During the meeting, the two officials reviewed relations between the two countries and discussed the latest regional and international developments and efforts to address them.
    
    -- SPA
19:17 Local Time 16:17 GMT
